    t = np.linspace(0, 2 * math.pi, 24, endpoint=False)
    pts = np.stack([50 + 20 * np.cos(t), 50 + 30 * np.sin(t)], 1)
    im = Image.new('L', (100, 100), 0)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
